videos.title: Google Pixel Tag | November '26 Pixel Drop
videos.summary: Google introduces Pixel Tag in the November '26 Pixel Drop, a tracker that helps you find missing items — including your phone. Part of the official Pixel Drop launch.

videos.title: Ramble On. Rambler Keeps Up. | November '26 Pixel Drop
videos.summary: Google's November '26 Pixel Drop campaign film introduces Rambler on Pixel 10 and Pixel 11 with Gemini Intelligence, turning natural speech into a clear message by cleaning up fillers and edits.

videos.title: “The Dreamer”: An Apple Holiday Film featuring MacBook Neo
videos.summary: Apple premieres its 2026 holiday film “The Dreamer,” directed by Melina Matsoukas — a story about a parent's gift that helps a young artist rediscover his creativity, featuring MacBook Neo.

videos.title: Introducing Withings Body Pro 3 for health programs
videos.summary: Withings introduces Body Pro 3, a segmental body-composition health station for digital health programs, with per-segment fat and muscle mass, program trajectory prediction, a hypertension notification pending FDA clearance, and cellular connectivity with no app setup for members.

videos.title: 【YA-MAN Official】NEW✨Deep Lift DUO
videos.summary: YA-MAN introduces Deep Lift DUO, its first multifunctional facial beauty device combining Warm Lift and Cool Lift in one device, so users can switch between warming and cooling care.
